children.game_version: Balance game stepping on taped lines on the floor simulating the bench.

seniors.counts: Simplified counts focusing on basic stepping patterns.
seniors.seated_version: Practice foot movements while seated, focusing on rhythm and balance awareness.
seniors.standing_version: Use a wider, stable platform for stepping to reduce fall risk; slower tempo.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and limited range of motion to ensure safety.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Used for balance, moving gracefully alongside footwork
movement_profile.footwork: Intricate stepping patterns on a narrow bench, including forward, backward, turns, and hops
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo or small groups taking turns on the bench; limited spatial movement due to bench size
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Stable but flexible to maintain equilibrium
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes small hops; advanced dancers perform faster and more complex footwork

signature_moves.description: Careful stepping along the narrow bench with precise foot placement
signature_moves.name: Bench Step

signature_moves.description: A small hop combined with a turn while balancing on the bench
signature_moves.name: Turn Hop

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Loss of balance leading to falls Overly rapid movements without control

music_profile.sound_description: The music features lively guitar and bandurria melodies with rhythmic percussion, creating an upbeat and festive atmosphere that supports dancers' footwork and balance.

basic_steps: Step onto the six-inch bench carefully, placing one foot at a time
Shift weight to maintain balance while lifting the other foot
Perform rhythmic stepping patterns forward and backward
Incorporate turns and small hops while balancing
Practice controlled arm movements to aid balance
teaching.formation: Solo or small groups taking turns on the bench
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on balance and simple stepping; intermediate dancers add turns and hops; advanced dancers perform complex footwork and faster tempos.
teaching.rhythm: Lively, upbeat traditional Filipino folk rhythms
